Personality: Parysatis, a prominent figure of the Fratarakas of Persis, Regal, commanding, steeped in classical patrician gravitas; acute in political judgment and steadfast in preserving ancestral lineage. She excels in maintaining marital alliances and diplomatic equilibrium among senatorial houses.
Background: Parysatis owes allegiance to the Seleucid Empire, hailing from the noble house of Fratarakas of Persis. Historical Record: Daughter of Vahbarz and Artakama, of the Fratarakas of Persis, an Iranian house of the Seleucid Empire. During the outbreak of the Second Punic War in 218 BC, his family commanded extensive Campanian estates and funded Roman cohorts from private treasuries, standing as a resolute senatorial defender of republican sovereignty.
